author: SGMC
body:
Hey, This is my second walls map, entitled Winter. It uses the basic walls layout but the center and ground is changed. The map is set in a snowy biome with a deserted house and mineshaft. Here are a couple screenshots of the map:The entire map is finished and has been tested, all that remains is the YAML file. The interesting thing about this map is that the ground between the sections is made of ice which can cause some interesting fights.
Map download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/b76j93d8dlmyp1a/Winter_walls_map_v1.0.zip
UPDATE: 6/26/2014, 7:35 AM
added:
-woodcutter's shack in forested area
-big spruce tree with chest
-improved caves
-rotated maps to be facing same corner
